entries: Take the union of the entries frozen for the direct PPO and fitted pair confirmations, the round-three field winner, the historical population champion and plain W-tap. Deduplicate byte-identical policies. Freeze before requesting new clock donors.
opponents: W-tap, Hold-W, the round-three field winner, each final training track's weakest distinct opponent, and archived switching policy shift-sealed-04. The switching policy is excluded from these fits but was used in prior project evaluations. Only the new match calendars are prospective.
trials: Use the recorded default floor, 20 CPS ceiling, prescribed integer mouse aim, 3-block reach and two-minute ring-outs. Each entry plays each seat at 0 and 80 ms symmetric RTT against every opponent. Use 12 independent native repeats per W-tap cell and three per other cell. All entrants use the same eight prospective timing donors in the simulation.
overall_title: Score each opponent equally. Rank by the average of mean opponent score, mean of the five weakest scores, and weakest opponent score. Break ties by overall mean, then prefer W-tap, then by name. Publish that native tournament winner as mmc13-final and best-sumo after verification. Each bot's W-tap dominance is a separate grade.
wtap_grade: Require at least 90 percent outright wins among 48 independent native W-tap duels, at least 10 of 12 in every seat and RTT cell, and at least 90 percent outright wins among 32 simulation duels. Preserve draws and report the weakest opponent, seat spread, and W-tap's score on the same schedule.
